summary:
The plan covers every phase 7 task checkbox: api/ (all 17 REST routes from §16.4, the WebSocket stream, live_* recording, ingest and ledger messages, --dump-openapi), schemas.py with the StreamMessage union, gen:types and the contract test, the web foundation, every live-theater element, both rails, and make dev/demo/e2e. A coverage table maps each checkbox to work steps.

Every SPEC test bullet has named tests: TestClient REST and WebSocket tests, replay determinism (fast and slow), the contract test plus check:types, Vitest for stores and formatting, and the Playwright specs for 5× play, rising stream and recorder counts, matches by T+90 and a new ledger block. axe-core runs on every route.

Every exit-check criterion maps to a command and the evidence it produces:
- make demo and make dev run in the background with time limits, and the plan stops them and shows the ports are free afterwards.
- make e2e, the screenshot review per §17.13, and perf.json with the CPU and macOS version for the frame rate.
- The D-010 resets going through the API, openapi.json and the generated types being current, and make test-all.

All ten non-negotiable rules are addressed, and I checked the riskiest claims against the repo:
- The append-only scan only matches ledger statements, so `DELETE FROM live_*` passes.
- The truth scan forbids the strings 'truth.duckdb', 'paths.truth' and 'truth_path'; the plan keeps them out of api/ and live/, and the new sink opens through connect_app_db.
- `incident_recorded` (written by live) and `model_registered` (written by system) are allowed writers in §15.2, so the system records do not break rule 8.
- `TrackStore.sql` is already part of the port.
- The fonts ship as .woff files, which the 3D text labels need.

The plan lists the two new package READMEs, seven README updates, PROGRESS.md, DECISIONS.md D-103 to D-118, and EXIT_CHECK.md and REPORT.md. Every open question is settled as a recorded assumption (A1 to A16), so no human decision is needed.
suggestions: Playwright concurrency: set `workers: 1` and `fullyParallel: false` in web/playwright.config.ts. All specs share one e2e server and one scratch ledger, and some tests call POST /api/admin/reseed. If spec files run in parallel workers (Playwright's default), a reseed in one worker can wipe the blocks another test is waiting for. That would make `make e2e` flaky.

Headless WebGL: wrap the R3F Canvas in an error boundary so a failed WebGL context cannot unmount the whole app and take the DOM panels the e2e asserts on with it. Also consider adding `--enable-unsafe-swiftshader` as a fallback launch flag, because recent Chromium no longer falls back to SwiftShader for WebGL on its own. Record the outcome next to the renderer string.

make dev and `concurrently`: §16.6 says `make dev` uses `concurrently`, but the plan keeps the existing `trap 'kill 0' …; api --reload & npm run dev & wait` recipe. That is fine, but A1–A16 do not record it. Add it to DECISIONS.md (rule 5).

§17.13 asks for screenshots at every Director beat, and Director mode is phase 8. The plan's substitute (first contact, T+45, T+90 and after approval, at both viewports) is reasonable; log it as a decision so the phase 8 reviewer knows to restore the per-beat set.

Exit-check block 2 runs `pkill -f "vite"`, which can kill unrelated Vite processes on the machine. Narrow the pattern (for example `pkill -f "web/node_modules/.bin/vite"`) or kill the background job's process group.

Fast-test runtime: three fast tests each run a full BRAVO precompute (95 reruns at about 100–250 ms each, so roughly 10–25 s per run): test_precompute_writes_every_rerun_second_and_features, test_cached_result_equals_computed and test_replay_precompute_then_fresh. Share one session-scoped precompute fixture, or limit the fast tests to a few rerun seconds and leave the full sweep to the slow test.

Message rate for the swarm incident: §16.3 asks for under 20 messages per second at 1×. Five tracks plus about 2.5 RF detections per second, plus up to one ingest per 100 ms tick per table, can push ECHO above 20 per second. Consider writing at most once per replay second (one batch per tick, every table in it), or extend test_stream_rate_under_20_per_second_at_1x to cover DEMO-SWARM-ECHO-0614.

Tokens in the 3D scene: say how three.js materials get their colors so `web/src/theme/tokens.css` stays the only styling vocabulary (CLAUDE.md, D-021). For example, read the CSS variables with getComputedStyle at mount, or keep a tokens.ts mirror with a Vitest test that checks it against tokens.css.

Name a Playwright `outputDir` that is already git-ignored. The plan adds `web/e2e-results/` to .gitignore; the existing entries cover the defaults `web/test-results/` and `web/playwright-report/`. Pick one so `git add -A` in step 11 never picks up test artifacts.
